title: Plugins
subtitle: Manage built-in local Codex plugins shipped with mimo2codex. Environment variables override UI toggles.

notice.title: First use detects adapters; missing adapters can be installed directly
notice.desc: The switch writes the built-in MCP server into Codex config. Before desktop operations, the plugin checks for the cross-platform Trope CUA adapter; when missing, run npm run install-adapter or let the model call computer_install_adapter and surface progress.

envLocked.title: {{envKey}} is set, so the UI toggle is read-only
envLocked.desc: The current environment value resolves to: {{value}}. Remove it and restart mimo2codex to use admin hot updates instead.

configMismatch.title: Plugin state and Codex config differ
configMismatch.desc: The plugin is expected to be enabled, but config.toml does not contain the MCP server yet. Refresh or toggle it again.

usage.title: How to use it after enabling
usage.desc: Restart Codex CLI / Desktop and the model can see computer_state, computer_click, computer_type, computer_key, computer_scroll, computer_wait, and computer_install_adapter MCP tools.
usage.prompt: Please call computer_state, inspect the current screen, and tell me the available next steps.

msg.enabled: Plugin enabled and Codex config updated; restart Codex to load it.
msg.disabled: Plugin disabled and removed from Codex config.
